## Commercial scope

APERTURE offers educational pathways, private coding lessons, digital gifts, sports and coaching work samples, and scoped workflow design. Pricing and availability are shown on the relevant page and should be confirmed before payment.

## Truth boundary

Public pages may contain interactive prototypes, simulations, and illustrative scenarios. They do not by themselves represent deployed agents, customer results, employer affiliations, private integrations, or guaranteed outcomes.
